title: From training to serving: registry, gates and rollback
design_ref: From training to serving: registry and promotion
purpose: Register a model, evaluate three versions on the same questions, refuse the one that got worse, promote the one that did not, roll it out, and roll it back.

steps.display: aws s3 rm s3://<bucket>/registry/ evals/ --recursive   # start from an empty registry
kubectl create -f job.yaml   # platform/reg-v1: modelops.py register --name qwen2.5-0.5b-instruct --source Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct --note 'base model'
kubectl -n platform logs job/reg-v1
kubectl create -f job.yaml   # platform/prune-v2: modelops.py prune --name qwen2.5-0.5b-instruct --parent v1 --sparsity 0.15 --note 'light compression'
kubectl -n platform logs job/prune-v2
kubectl create -f job.yaml   # platform/prune-v3: modelops.py prune --name qwen2.5-0.5b-instruct --parent v1 --sparsity 0.80 --note 'aggressive compression'
kubectl -n platform logs job/prune-v3
kubectl create -f batch-eval.yaml   # eval-v1: evaluate qwen2.5-0.5b-instruct/v1 on a borrowed GPU
kubectl -n batch-eval logs job/eval-v1 | tail -1
kubectl create -f batch-eval.yaml   # eval-v2: evaluate qwen2.5-0.5b-instruct/v2 on a borrowed GPU
kubectl -n batch-eval logs job/eval-v2 | tail -1
kubectl create -f batch-eval.yaml   # eval-v3: evaluate qwen2.5-0.5b-instruct/v3 on a borrowed GPU
kubectl -n batch-eval logs job/eval-v3 | tail -1

checks.description: version v1 is registered with its files and checksums
checks.because: The registry job downloaded the weights and wrote them, with a manifest of SHA-256 sums, to an immutable version path in S3.

checks.description: two candidates were derived from v1 by pruning, and each records its parent and transform
checks.because: The manifest of a derived version names its parent and the transform applied, so lineage is never lost.

checks.description: all three versions were evaluated on the same 30 questions, on a GPU borrowed from the serving queue
checks.because: The evaluation job is created by the registry, not by a person, and runs through the batch queue.

checks.description: v1 is promoted: the first version has no production baseline to beat
checks.because: The gates are a quality floor, a throughput floor, and a checksum check.

checks.description: v3 (80% of weights removed) is REFUSED by the quality gate
checks.because: Its score is far below production's. The refusal and its reasons are written to the audit trail anyway.
Light pruning keeps the answers: its score is within the allowed regression of v1's.

checks.description: the production pointer now names v2 and the audit trail holds all three decisions
checks.because: A promotion moves a one-line pointer; every decision, approved or not, adds an audit record.

checks.description: the server runs exactly the version the production pointer names (v2)
checks.because: The init container reads the pointer and copies that version. Serving never reads a training bucket.

checks.description: the rollback put v1 back in service
checks.because: Rolling back is another pointer change and a restart, not a rebuild.
